prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Sign in now to permanently save your newly customized pet to your account."]
1: ["How to Control Your Desktop Pet", "Here are quick shortcuts to manage your pet anytime on your desktop.", "Right-click pet for main options menu", "Click pet to chat or feed", "Drag and drop anywhere across your screens"]
2: ["Select Companion"]
3: ["Generating your custom companion...", "Tip: Right-click your pet on the desktop anytime for quick controls."]
4: ["Signing in links your pet safely to cloud backup so you never lose pet stats or items."]
5: ["Use a bright, clear photo with a single main subject for best rendering results.", "Clear subject and simple background", "Good ambient lighting"]
6: ["Pet missing? Press Ctrl+Shift+P anytime to bring your companion to the front.", "Test Summon Hotkey"]
7: ["Select Your Journey & Claim 500 Bonus Pet Treats", "+500 Bonus Treats Included"]
8: []
9: ["Official Adoption Certificate", "Give your new companion a name to finalize adoption!", "Pet Name"]

verdicts.problem: Mentions bonus treats and free extras
